thread:
Ethan R: FYI discovered 43 duplicate credit memos in NetSuite tied to refunds processed on 2026-02-03. Recon flagged them as possible double-applies. Anyone on refunds flow?

Billing Bot: Alert: 2026-02-03T23:12:10Z 1 duplicates created for refund batch id rb_20260203_09 during netsuite-import. Error signature: missing idempotency_key.

Lina K: ugh. I think this is related to the retry shim we added for transient Stripe 5xxs (PR #4980). If the netsuite-import returned 500, the retry path re-sent the same payload but we forgot to attach netsuite idempotency header in the retry branch. Normal path sets `X-NS-Idempotency: refund_<stripe_refund_id>`, retry path didn't.

Sam T: can you paste an example of the refund payload and the import request headers?

Lina K: sample request body (redacted):
```
{ "refund_id": "re_1LaXz9", "stripe_charge": "ch_1LaXyL", "amount": 2500, "customer": "cus_9Z", "reason": "requested_by_customer" }
```
Request headers normal: `X-NS-Idempotency: refund_re_1LaXz9`
Retry request headers (from logs): `User-Agent: netsuite-import/2.1` (no idempotency header)

Olga P: NetSuite created memos for the retryed ones because it never saw the idempotency key. We now have duplicates applied to AR for 43 customers, and some cash application mismatches. Not critical outage but mess for month-end.

Ethan R: key asks: how many dupes, how to reverse safely, and fix deploy plan. Lina, Sam can you run a scope query for refunds between 2026-02-03T00:00 and 2026-02-04T02:00 and return the stripe_refund_id list?

Lina K: running now. ETA 10m.

Billing Bot: Job started: refund-dupe-scan v1. Querying events...

Lina K: scan done: found 43 refunds with two corresponding netsuite_memo_id entries in the mapping table. Exporting CSV to /tmp/refund_dupes_20260203.csv and creating a safe revert plan.

Sam T: revert plan suggestion: 1) create a reversal memo for the duplicate memos (do not void the original), 2) add a comment link to stripe refund id, 3) update mapping table to mark duplicate_memo=true, 4) patch retry path to include idempotency header and ship hotfix. Any objections?

Olga P: approve reversal memos. We should not void the originals because some have been reconciled to bank deposits. Reversal memos are safer for audit trail. Also we need a short customer comms for any invoices that briefly showed incorrect balance.

Ethan R: OK proceed. Lina: please make the hotfix PR and include a migration script to backfill missing idempotency header markers for the affected runs. Put a toggle in config so we can disable retry header injection if needed. Open a Jira for the rollback and fixes.

Lina K: PR opened: #5012 1 hotfix branch `fix/refund-retry-idempotency`. Added migration `20260204_backfill_refund_idempotency` to mark netsuite-mapping rows missing idempotency.

Billing Bot: Task created: FIN-1078 netsuite duplicate refund cleanup (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-1078).

Sam T: I'll deploy the hotfix to staging for verification. Also adding an integration test that asserts retry requests include `X-NS-Idempotency`.

Lina K: running automated reversal script on staging now. Example dry-run output: would create 43 reversal memos, no reconciled deposits impacted in dry-run mode.

Olga P: please schedule the reversal job for off-peak (US morning) and notify Accounting. I'll prepare the journal entries for the reversal memos.

Ethan R: thanks. Keep thread updated when staging looks good and when production run is scheduled. :thumbsup:

Lina K: staging verified. Deploying hotfix to prod in 15m with maintenance note to Accounting. Running reversal job post-deploy.
